notes.title: Level Editor, new content (Update 1.20)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32349145/d480f55ae22fc3b60f37f6f06835393b3eb4372f.png[/img]

[h1]Today we bring You an in-game Level Editor.[/h1]
On April 21, 2018, we released MGA in Early Access along with the "Scene Export Tool", which allowed players to create their maps and upload them to the Workshop.

[b]Now you can create your own original maps, upload them to the Workshop without leaving the game in the "Level Editor".[/b]

[h1]Features Of Level Editor:[/h1]
[list]
    [*]You can create and edit the landscape. 
[i]For example, change the height of the landscape, smooth it, paint more than 80 textures. 
You can also place more than 16 types of grass on the landscape.[/i]
    [*]Material Editor
    [*]You can paint every object in the game.
    [*]You can create huge maps in size 3000x3000x3000 meters!
    [*]A huge variety of objects.
    [*]Snap feature.
[i]And much more.[/i]
[/list]

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Interface update (leaderboard, friends and more).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32349145/ce6740c883ac97d310711b4ce1c001c59fec971b.jpg[/img]
[*]Added 7 new types of balls.
[*]Added new trail.
[*]Added [b]Level Editor[/b].
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32349145/9a51e57b4cccd6b5c45864566d79e09c165b6dc7.jpg[/img]
[*]Added voice game score (From Hole In One to Triple Bogey).
[*]Game engine update.
[*]Ball control is improved. Now smoother and more comfortable.
[*]Improved graphics on golf courses "ELBRUS", "SYSTEM".
[*]Added the ability to [b]jump[/b] (to jump press LMB).
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32349145/75cedab8c5c1a5158e255aadd5fe4303d53e39ed.jpg[/img]
[*]Added [b]collisions[/b] in multiplayer.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32349145/5d7f5097894de1efdecb0ae513338cdd941d8e3a.jpg[/img]
[i]Players can now push other players balls.[/i]
[/list]

Discord - https://discordapp.com/invite/evolutastudio

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1497271526
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1500019080
